title: Release SemVer evidence pack (v1)
description: The .github#2260 (ADR-0033) release evidence pack as normalised by its reusable release-tag workflow at dccacc77: the same member names, arrays of plain strings, previous_version, and the api_surface_inspected rule, closed and size-bounded. It carries no identifiers of its own and no version decision; the receipt envelope binds it by evidence_sha256, the SHA-256 of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON form (v1 packs contain no JSON numbers).
$comment: Immutable once released: any change requires a new vN directory and MANIFEST entry. Resolve every $ref from the packaged schema files through a local registry; never retrieve a $id over the network. Consumers must also reject documents larger than 262144 UTF-8 bytes.

previous_version.description: Canonical three-component SemVer of the previous release without a v prefix. #2260 derives it from the latest tag and falls back to 0.0.0 when no tag exists; how that fallback is treated is an unresolved owner decision (ADR 0137).

api_surface_inspected.description: True only when the public API surface was actually inspected. As in #2260, a pack that is not marked inspected must carry at least one removed/renamed/required-arg finding.

item.description: One evidence string. Like #2260's API lists, it must contain a non-whitespace character.
